Body.Content:
What and why

Copilot in the desktop app will be able to use content from open webpage tabs in the app's built-in browser as page context. Users will be able to ask questions or request summaries for a single tab or across multiple tabs, which helps with multi-tab workflows. Page context will be scoped to the current conversation and will apply only when the built-in browser is enabled. 

Availability is limited to the Microsoft Copilot desktop app.

Rollout schedule

  • General availability (Worldwide): We will begin rolling out in mid-November 2026 and expect to complete the rollout in late November 2026.

Impact on your organization

Who is affected

  • Users of the Copilot desktop app in organizations where the built-in browser is enabled
  • Admins who manage the Copilot desktop app and its built-in browser

Platforms and services

  • Copilot desktop app (built-in browser)
  • Microsoft 365 Copilot

What will happen

  • When the built-in browser is enabled, Copilot will be able to use content from open webpage tabs in that browser to answer questions and provide summaries: 

  • Users will be able to ask about a single tab or across multiple tabs: 

  • Page context will be limited to the current conversation.
  • If the built-in browser is disabled, this feature will not be active and will have no impact.

Action required and recommendations

No action is required. We recommend that you:

  • Confirm whether the Copilot desktop app built-in browser is enabled for your organization.
  • Review the governance settings for in-app browsing and page context use.
  • Validate the expected behavior with pilot users.
  • Tell users and helpdesk staff that page context is limited to the current conversation.

Compliance considerations

QuestionAnswer
Does the change introduce or significantly modify AI/ML or agent capabilities that interact with customer data?Yes. Copilot uses content from open webpage tabs in the built-in browser as context for answers and summaries.
Does the change give users a new way of interacting with generative AI?Yes. Users can ask questions or request summaries for one tab or across multiple tabs.

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Page context for open tabs in the Copilot desktop app built-in browser
